@@U02616@@
Enter 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特.

@@U02618@@
What is it with these gloomy passageways?
Why are you always dragging me off here?
Isn't there pleasure enough in there?
Do they bore you,
that colorful crowd of courtiers?
Not opportunity enough for your tricks and pranks?
Is that it?

@@U02620@@
Spare me your drivel!
You ran out of tricks long ago,
and now you chase around trying to avoid me.
Look, I’m being pressured.
The Emperor insists on seeing Paris and 海伦—
and he wants it here, now, without delay—
clear images, there, in front of him,
of the ideal man and the ideal woman.
So get busy! Now!
I gave my word, I can’t break it!

@@U02622@@
What a thoughtless fool to make such a promise!

@@U02624@@
No, old friend, you're the thoughtless fool.
You failed to consider where your arts would lead us.
First we made him rich,
and now were meant to amuse him.

@@U02626@@
It’s not a matter of snapping your fingers and presto!
This is alien territory you're invading,
and the steps are steep and winding.
You'll end up getting wickedly involved again,
translation:
@@U02616@@
浮士德和梅菲斯特登场。

@@U02618@@
这些阴暗的通道是怎么回事？
你为什么总是把我拖到这里？
难道里面的乐趣还不够吗？
他们让你厌烦吗，
那一群色彩斑斓的朝臣？
没有足够的机会施展你的诡计和恶作剧？
是这样吗？

@@U02620@@
饶了我你的胡言乱语吧！
你早就用尽了伎俩，
现在你却四处追赶并试图避开我。
你看，我压力很大。
皇上执意要见帕里斯和海伦——
他想要在这里，现在，毫不拖延地——
清晰的影像就在他面前，
理想的男人和理想的女人。
所以忙起来吧！现在！
我已经答应了，我不能食言！

@@U02622@@
做出这样的承诺真是一个没有思想的傻瓜！

@@U02624@@
不，老朋友，你是个没有思想的傻瓜。
你没有考虑到你的艺术将引领我们走向何方。
首先我们让他变得富有，
现在是为了逗他开心。

@@U02626@@
这不是打响指和急转直下的问题！
这是你正在入侵的外星领地
而且台阶陡峭蜿蜒。
你最终会再次参与邪恶的事情，
